fixed_spectrum_sample: first 4096 physical records; nine input fields; hold unknown/NIST-labelled ingest; no labels or structures selected
fixed_numeric_sample: first 128 sorted G values in each M regime; unchanged candidate rows and existing features

column_contract.Y: binary truth; one positive per selected query group and regime
column_contract.M: binary saved regime; repeated regimes are not independent samples
column_contract.score_column_15: existing fingerprint feature; verify your exact original source contract
column_contract.score_column_21: existing fragment-explanation feature; verify your exact original source contract

grouping: no cross-row consensus; metadata availability and spacing only
ranking_metric: uniform exact-tie expected reciprocal rank at 25; paired fragment-minus-fingerprint
scientific_limit: exposed development; no new matcher ranking, fitted-control comparison or hidden transfer
